individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial feature/heatmap plot of deconvolution scores over tissue coordinates; each spot already represents an individual measurement, so overlaid individual points are not required (heatmap-type visualization).

error-bars-defined.explanation: This is a spatial heatmap-style plot with a color scale, no error bars or box/whisker elements are present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as they already depict the data distribution; individual points are additionally overlaid as dots.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (median, IQR bounds, minima and maxima) are explicitly defined with numeric values for each group in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment score line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement (line plots).

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars appear on the enrichment score line plots; only NES, FDR and P values are reported.

individual-data-points.explanation: Bar graph shows an aggregated log2(fold change) value per gene (derived from differential expression analysis across many spots) without displaying any underlying individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown on the fold-change bar graph; only single bars with associated p-values are plotted.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot, so this check does not apply.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E consists of histology/IHC micrographs, not a plot, so this check does not apply.
